description: This file defines the MultipartStream class, which implements a stream for handling multipart/form-data uploads in HTTP requests within GuzzleHttp. It constructs and manages multipart streams including headers, boundaries, and individual elements.

classes.name: MultipartStream
classes.description: A stream that constructs and represents a multipart/form-data payload for HTTP requests, supporting boundary management and element addition.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new MultipartStream instance with given elements and optional boundary.

methods.name: getBoundary
methods.description: Returns the boundary string used to separate multipart elements.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is writable; returns false.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Generates headers for a given part based on provided headers array.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates the main stream by aggregating all multipart elements.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds an individual element to the multipart stream, handling headers and content.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Generates the stream and headers for an individual multipart element.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a specific header value case-insensitively from headers array.
